SHRINK-ONLY from its first commit: a row may only fall, through its door (node scripts/fact-layers-door.mjs --shrink), in the commit that cures it; no row is ever added and nothing is raised. leaves: each leaf of src/domain/facts/factLayers.js that touches a stratum at or above its own layer, with the strata (the two bundled leaves of the layer map's §2c — the defence object and the crisis home — and what reads through them; the crime structure reading the back-written crime lines; the faith reading touching the cast). pools: each corpus pool whose lines declare or name a fact at or above the pool's layer (factLayers.poolTable.json). readers: per file, per fact family, EACH LINE (its code, whitespace collapsed) that answers a homed fact again by a name test outside its home, with its reason (the defence-reader walker generalised; the defence words stay that walker's). W2-A-LEAVES-2 (REVIEW-W2A F6): banked by content, not by count, so a swap inside a file is red; the facts folder is read like any other except each family's homes; a call of the home's own reader is not a name test.

_reasons.pools: a line that reads a fact its pool is not above: the pool is re-placed by what its key reads, or the line declares through a lower leaf
